plan.cpu: production stele_pcs PreparedSource::hiding_with (Policy::Two, blowup 2) then certificate() and verify_certificate(), on rayon's pool; the masked rounds as in E16-35 (stele_reductions::zk::claims::bench, now with E16-34's base-field rounds and lazy QM31 product)
plan.gpu: research/gpu-gating/masked/src/source.cu: M' uploaded, transposed to symbol-major on the device, inverse Circle levels on the head, bit reversal and 1/n scale, forward levels on the whole (twiddles from the host, RFC-0010 A2), leaves hashed one per thread with the keyed-XOF salts computed on the device, one launch per tree level; only the root is read back. The certificate stays on the CPU. One untimed warm-up pass per process.

projection.gate: GO only if the measured resident ceiling is at least 3x (E16-36)
projection.method: Amdahl on bench/ledger/e16-36-dev-zk-stories42m-t32-mac.json laps (single run, 306.16 s): T' = r + rel/s_rel + gkr/s_gkr + S/s_src + L/s_L; r = 85.44 s outside ADR-120's offloadable set; relations 22.45 s at s_rel, ZK-GKR 153.19 s at s_gkr, each at its own measured ratio; source preparation S = 28.34 s at s_src; LogUp trees and tops + claim batches L = 16.74 s. s_src is the Mac CPU's (prepare + certificate) over (device encode + Merkle + the Mac's certificate) at the witness shape (13.31x). s_rel (31.7-57.7x) and s_gkr (15.9-18.4x) are against the box CPU: the Mac masked calibration did not run (host load 8-11). The Mac ran these rounds slower than such a box in E16-35, so box-calibrated ratios understate the device's gain on the laps host and bias the ceiling toward NO-GO.
projection.trees_batches_ratio_needed_for_3x: s_L >= L / (T/3 - r - rel/s_rel - gkr/s_gkr - S/s_src): 2.91x-4.05x with the box-calibrated s_rel, s_gkr; 1.35x-1.66x with ADR-123's Mac-calibrated 39.7-83.4x (before E16-34) over all of M
projection.verdict: NO-GO at this measurement (ADR-127): measured 2.67x-2.71x (box-calibrated); the 2.996x bound assumes LogUp trees and claim batches on the CPU and is within single-run noise of 3x (0.19 s of a 306 s prove)

note: E16-36 dev-zk GPU decision benchmark (RFC-0014 §1, §5; ADR-127). prover_time_ns is the sum of the GPU phases (upload + encode + Merkle for the three source shapes; upload + build + rounds for the six masked cells) from each cell's median run; per-cell GPU times are in stage_times_ns, CPU times in kernel_counters (ns). Device roots equal the production roots at every source shape. plan_digest is the SHA-256 of research/gpu-gating/masked/results36.txt. The commit is the main the box tree was copied from. The projection is an estimate, not a GPU prover measurement. Micro schema proof, verifier and control fields are zero: no inference evidence is claimed. Not a cost-model fit input.
